                name = ?, original_title = ?, publisher_id = ?, format_id = ?, series_id = ?,
                series_index = ?, publication_date = ?, last_modified_date = ?, isbn = ?,
                notes = ?, has_cover = ?, has_paper = ?, file_link = ?,
                file_size = ?, file_hash = ?
            WHERE id = ?
